mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy that reduces the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC of FEDFUNDS trend against 20-day SPX returns falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window, or the signal fails to produce positive returns in more than 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate falls below 0.15%, it indicates aggressive monetary easing, which typically precedes positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The signal triggers when FEDFUNDS < 0.15, but 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate combined with strong employment growth signals an economy in recovery with labor market tightness, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to inflation concerns.
failure_condition: The interaction condition holds (PAYEMS>130000 and UNRATE>9.5%), but 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of such cases.

mechanism_narrative: In the post-shock recovery regime, rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate improving consumer confidence and construction activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The signal is active in post-shock recovery, but 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when HOUST rises.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) reflects expanding manufacturing output, which typically supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The INDPRO trend fails to predict positive returns in more than 50% of instances over 5-day horizons.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts exceed 550 thousand units, it signals robust demand for new homes, which typically precedes positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The signal triggers when HOUST > 550, but 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of such cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, rising consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) indicates central bank efforts to curb inflation, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The signal is active in monetary tightening cycles, but 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate combined with weak employment growth (PAYEMS below 130000) signals an economy in distress, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction condition holds (UNRATE>9.5 and PAYEMS<130000), but 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of such cases.
